758:t_1:578.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hah! It's the idiot on the receiving end who's to blame!」

758:t_1:579.en:
$$アキ$$
「Honestly, $$勝平$$! You haven't changed at all!」

758:t_1:580.en:
$$ミチ$$
「It's all right. We've finally got peace back, after all.」

758:t_1:581.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「...Jeez, we haven't seen each other in ages, and this is what happens...」

758:t_1:582.en:
$$梅江$$
「I'm sorry, you two. You came all the way from Nagano and $$東京$$, too.」

758:t_1:583.en:
$$恵子$$
「It's all right, Grandma. There's still time before the signing ceremony.」

758:t_1:584.en:
$$一太郎$$
「We're leaving $$ザンボット$$ and $$ビアル$$ with the military... Are you really sure about this, Grandpa?」

758:t_1:585.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「The fighting is over now. Besides, we're only entrusting them with the machines temporarily.」

758:t_1:587.en:
$$恵子$$
「Are we... going to pilot $$ザンボット$$ again?」

758:t_1:588.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「That's for you to decide. Surely fighting isn't the only use for $$ザンボット$$.」

758:t_1:589.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「Once you've learned many things and can make sound decisions, use $$ザンボット$$ as you see fit.」

758:t_1:590.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then I... want to work with $$ザンボット$$, like $$ワッ太$$ does!」

758:t_1:591.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll call it the $$神グレートカンパニー$$, the hyperdimensional world's jack-of-all-trades!」

758:t_1:592.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Don't decide that on your own. $$ザンボット$$ belongs to all three of us.」

758:t_1:593.en:
$$勝平$$
「What!? Are you against it, $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$!?」

758:t_1:594.en:
$$恵子$$
「I haven't decided yet. ...But your idea isn't bad, $$勝平$$.」

758:t_1:596.en:
$$勝平$$
「When we start the company, I'll be President, Big Bro $$イチ$$ will be Executive Director, and I'll make $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$ department heads!」

758:t_1:597.en:
$$一太郎$$
「$$勝平$$ will be President, huh...」

758:t_1:598.en:
$$花江$$
「If you want to lead people, you'll have to study harder too.」

758:t_1:599.en:
$$勝平$$
「I can manage just fine without doing that!」

758:t_1:600.en:
$$源五郎$$
「No, $$勝平$$. Nobody will follow a man who runs away from the difficulties in front of him.」

758:t_1:601.en:
$$源五郎$$
「Look at $$ワッ太$$. Whatever he said, he always finished all his homework in the end.」

758:t_1:603.en:
$$源五郎$$
「Pay attention and take your classes seriously. Next summer, you'll have more than homework to worry about.」

758:t_1:605.en:
$$源五郎$$
「That's right. I'll take you fishing with me.」

758:t_1:606.en:
$$勝平$$
「All right! I'll finally be a man of the sea!」

758:t_1:607.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「Learn all you can, $$勝平$$... You too, $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$, for the bright future ahead of you.」

758:t_1:608.en:
$$勝平$$
(I'll do it... I'll go out to sea and become a stronger man.)

758:t_1:609.en:
$$勝平$$
(And someday, I'll sail the sea of space with $$ザンボット$$ and go see $$ワッ太$$ and everyone else...!)

758:t_1:613.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「...$$万丈$$, your client has arrived.」

758:t_1:614.en:
$$万丈$$
「Understood. Please welcome our guest politely and show them in here.」

758:t_1:616.en:
$$トッポ$$
「You've finally got a client, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」

758:t_1:617.en:
$$レイカ$$
「It's the $$破嵐探偵事務所$$'s first job.」

758:t_1:618.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「So what is the job?」

758:t_1:619.en:
$$万丈$$
「I decided not to ask in advance. We're hardly in a position to pick and choose our work.」

758:t_1:620.en:
$$万丈$$
「But I'm certain of one thing. The client is a very beautiful woman.」

758:t_1:622.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'm confident I was born under that sort of star.」

758:t_1:624.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「That's right. You have an assistant like me, after all.」

758:t_1:625.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Oh, $$ビューティ$$. Shouldn't I be the one saying that?」

758:t_1:626.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「What are you talking about? Obviously, that's my line!」

758:t_1:628.en:
$$万丈$$
「Let's leave it there, you two. $$ギャリソン$$ will be showing our client in soon.」

758:t_1:630.en:
$$万丈$$
「This is where my new battle begins.」

758:t_1:631.en:
$$万丈$$
(And the sun is with me. It will always be with this world too...)

758:t_1:632.en:
$$万丈$$
(Thank you, $c... I'll never forget the days we fought together.)

758:t_1:636.en:
$$メール$$
「...Which way are we going, Darling?」

758:t_1:637.en:
$$ランド$$
「We could go east or west... Wherever the wind blows, wherever the mood takes us...」

758:t_1:638.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's $$ビーター・サービス$$, the wandering repair crew.」

758:t_1:640.en:
$$メール$$
「That's what I'd like to say, but our business has plenty of problems, so we have to go where the work is!」

758:t_1:641.en:
$$ランド$$
「We've finally got a new world, and life is still tough...」

758:t_1:642.en:
???
「Hey, you're still talking about hard times, as usual.」

758:t_1:644.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Well, don't worry. There's a reconstruction boom after the space-time repair. $$ビーター・サービス$$ should get in on it too.」

758:t_1:647.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Looks like I worried you, $$メール$$. ...I should've contacted you first if I knew this would happen...」

758:t_1:648.en:
$$ランド$$
「Contacted us...? Boss, you knew where we were?」

758:t_1:649.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Sure did. Dr. Fox told me about you two.」

758:t_1:650.en:
$$メール$$
「Dr. Fox...? You mean Dr. $$トライア$$!?」

758:t_1:651.en:
$$ランド$$
「How do you and Sis $$トライア$$ know each other, Boss!?」

758:t_1:652.en:
$$シエロ$$
「How...? I was the chief mechanic for the $$ソーラリアン$$.」

758:t_1:654.en:
$$シエロ$$
「After it was finished, I maintained the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$s, and finally became chief engineer on the $$スヴェル$$.」

758:t_1:655.en:
$$シエロ$$
「So I was supporting Earth and you two behind the scenes too.」

758:t_1:657.en:
$$ランド$$
「No matter how busy you were, you could've stopped by for a moment!」

758:t_1:658.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Don't be ridiculous! How could the retired old owner keep dropping in on $$ビーター・サービス$$ after turning it over to you!?」

758:t_1:659.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Besides, I'm not so tactless that I'd intrude on a newlywed couple.」

758:t_1:661.en:
$$ランド$$
「Like daughter, like father... You haven't changed, Boss...」

758:t_1:662.en:
$$メール$$
「But I'm glad. You approve of me marrying Darling.」

758:t_1:663.en:
$$シエロ$$
「You wore me down. A father doesn't stand a chance when it's already a done deal.」
